body.name: Generic four-wave initial-absorber allocation pair
body.construction: Let \(P^\circ\) be any regular law in \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\) with no date-\(1\) absorption, let \(0<\varepsilon<1\), and choose labels \(h\neq k\). Form \(P_\varepsilon^A\) and \(P_\varepsilon^B\) by mixing weight \(1-\varepsilon\) of the complete four-wave law \(P^\circ\) with weight \(\varepsilon\) on the path \(X_t(0)=X_t(1)=e\) for \(t=0,1,2,3\), assigning this added mass to label \(h\) in \(P_\varepsilon^A\) and label \(k\) in \(P_\varepsilon^B\), in every cohort. Thus the added observed atom is \(\delta_{(e,e,e,e)}\). The labels and all active-state kernels of the retained component are unchanged. Define \(P^A,P^B\) as the specialization \(P^\circ=\omega^\star\), \(\varepsilon=1/5\), \(h=1\), and \(k=2\). The observational equivalence and effect formulas are proved in \(\texttt{prop:exact-boundary-witness}\).
